inspection_summary: Inspected all 1804 logical lines. The survey moves from Euler products, analytic continuation, explicit formulas, and equivalent criteria into spectral, random-matrix, statistical-mechanical, stochastic, experimental, and fractal representations of zeta. Formula extraction is uneven but the selected mechanisms are recoverable from checked prose; formula-dependent units explicitly retain scan-verification cautions. References and page furniture were inspected and excluded. The three frozen v1 units are carried unchanged, with one bounded continuation repair.

sections_inspected.label: Front matter and abstract
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Identifies the review's two-part number-theory and physics scope; otherwise publication furniture.

sections_inspected.label: Introduction
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Motivates physical methods for RH and previews the review's sequence of viewpoints.

sections_inspected.label: Prime Number Theorem and zeta foundations
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Develops prime counting, Euler product and continuation, explicit formulas, functional symmetry, RH, computational verification, and products over zeros.

sections_inspected.label: Criteria for proving RH
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Surveys prime-error, de Bruijn-Newman, integral, divisor-sum, and skepticism criteria.

sections_inspected.label: Quantum mechanics and RH

accepted_units.title: From infinitude to asymptotic prime counting
accepted_units.why_material: Contrasts a contradiction proof and Euler's divergent prime harmonic sum with Gauss's shift to a smooth asymptotic model for an erratic counting function.
accepted_units.context_note: The concrete examples illustrate the historical transition; the reusable content is the move from existence to distributional approximation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; equations (1)-(2) are legible and the mechanism is stated in prose.

accepted_units.title: Euler product turns unique factorization into an analytic object
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how geometric-series expansion plus unique prime factorization identifies a Dirichlet series with a product and converts absence of vanishing factors into a zero-free half-plane.
accepted_units.context_note: This is the source's foundational bridge from multiplicative arithmetic to complex analysis.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equation (4) is formula-dependent but readable, and prose supplies the logical steps.

accepted_units.title: Analytic continuation changes the domain of the zeta problem
accepted_units.why_material: Separates the Euler product's convergence region from the continued function's nearly global domain and records gamma-function singularities as part of that extension.
accepted_units.context_note: Overlaps the Euler-product unit because the distinction between the original representation and its continuation is the conceptual point.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; the contour in equation (6) is extraction-defective, so only the checked prose-level continuation and domain claims are accepted and the displayed integral needs scan verification.

accepted_units.title: Prime powers and Mobius inversion recover prime counts
accepted_units.why_material: Introduces a weighted prime-power staircase, recovers the prime-counting function by Mobius inversion, and relates the reciprocal Euler product to square-free parity.
accepted_units.context_note: The fermionic interpretation is presented as an additional representation of the same square-free exclusion structure.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equations (8)-(11) are needed, with minor text-layer damage but recoverable prose.

accepted_units.title: Zeros collectively reconstruct the prime-power staircase
accepted_units.why_material: The exact formula replaces direct prime input by a sum over zeta zeros and explains their collective role in turning a smooth term into discontinuous arithmetic structure.
accepted_units.context_note: The branch-choice discussion is essential: complex logarithm ambiguity must be resolved through an exponential-integral representation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equations (12)-(14) and branch conventions are central, but the prose makes the mechanism recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Functional symmetry organizes trivial and nontrivial zeros
accepted_units.why_material: Derives the critical-strip localization and fourfold symmetry pattern from the functional equation and gamma singularities.
accepted_units.context_note: This supplies the geometric zero-locus setup used by later criteria and physical analogies.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equation (15) has imperfect symbols, while the symmetry and strip are explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Explicit prime formulas require a natural ordering of zeros
accepted_units.why_material: Refines the explicit formula, separates trivial-zero terms, and explains that conditional convergence makes the pairing and ordering of nontrivial zeros mathematically consequential.
accepted_units.context_note: The Fourier-step analogy explains collective oscillatory reconstruction without treating a truncation as exact.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; displayed equations (16)-(19) are extraction-damaged and require scan verification, but conditional-ordering and staircase claims are clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: RH controls oscillatory corrections to prime counting
accepted_units.why_material: Links the computational utility of explicit formulas, diminishing trivial-zero contributions, and RH's placement of every nontrivial zero on the critical line.
accepted_units.context_note: The numerical records are illustrative rather than proof evidence; the reusable content is the dominance and zero-location structure.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equations (20)-(21) matter, with prose sufficient for the qualitative mechanism.

accepted_units.title: Under RH, zeta zeros become waves whose derivative localizes primes
accepted_units.why_material: Rewrites the explicit formula as oscillatory modes and differentiates the reconstructed staircase to obtain prime-centered delta-like spikes.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a concrete representation change from complex zeros to a signal-processing picture.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equation (22) is severely mangled in extraction, so the exact coefficients need scan verification although the wave and derivative mechanism is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Analytic zero-free control proves PNT while finite zero checks only test RH
accepted_units.why_material: Contrasts the proof-relevant zero-free line that yields PNT with large finite computations and positive-proportion results that do not establish all-zero criticality.
accepted_units.context_note: Preserves the distinction between theorem, finite verification, and asymptotic statistical investigation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low to moderate; the zero-count formula is readable enough and the evidence distinction is prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Hadamard factorization represents zeta through its zeros
accepted_units.why_material: Provides the complementary global product in which zero locations determine the function, contrasting it with the prime Euler product.
accepted_units.context_note: This completes the source's prime-side versus zero-side factorization duality.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equation (24) has text-layer damage but the factorization role is explicit.

accepted_units.title: The de Bruijn-Newman deformation makes RH a boundary question
accepted_units.why_material: Carries the frozen v1 unit linking prime-counting error criteria to a heat-like deformation whose real-zero threshold frames RH as barely true if true.
accepted_units.context_note: Frozen v1 span is preserved exactly and is coherent without repair.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equations (25)-(30) are central and should be checked against the scan before formula-level reuse.

accepted_units.title: Equivalent integral and divisor-sum tests expose RH's delicacy
accepted_units.why_material: Carries the frozen v1 survey of integral equalities and elementary divisor-sum inequalities equivalent to RH, including near-threshold computations.
accepted_units.context_note: Frozen v1 span is preserved exactly and closes with the source's delicacy interpretation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; several displayed criteria have OCR damage and require scan verification for exact constants and quantifiers.

accepted_units.title: Hilbert-Polya reframes RH as spectral reality and Montgomery links gaps to random matrices
accepted_units.why_material: Carries the frozen v1 unit from the proposed self-adjoint spectral explanation of real zero ordinates to Montgomery's repulsion law and Dyson's random-matrix recognition.
accepted_units.context_note: Frozen v1 boundaries are preserved, but the final heavy-nucleus motivation continues beyond the span and is requested as a context repair.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; pair-correlation equation (35) is extraction-damaged, while the spectral and repulsion interpretation is clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: Unfolding reveals symmetry-class level repulsion
accepted_units.why_material: Builds the random-matrix model, explains unfolding away the mean spectral trend, and organizes level statistics by Hamiltonian symmetry classes.
accepted_units.context_note: Completes the physical motivation cut off by the carried unit and supplies the comparison statistic used for zeta zeros.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equations (36)-(37) are useful but prose defines GUE, unfolding, and universality classes.

accepted_units.title: Odlyzko gap statistics infer broken time-reversal symmetry and quantum chaos
accepted_units.why_material: Uses progressively higher zero computations to support GUE behavior and then infers constraints on any candidate spectral system: broken time reversal and chaotic classical dynamics.
accepted_units.context_note: This is solver-conditional empirical evidence for a representation class, not a proof of RH or existence of an operator.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; the inference chain is stated in prose.

accepted_units.title: The xp Hamiltonian matches the leading zero count but fails as the required operator
accepted_units.why_material: Shows both the appeal of matching the spectral counting asymptotic and why that match is insufficient: special regularization, wrong subleading behavior in analogues, continuous spectrum, and integrability.
accepted_units.context_note: The source itself supplies counterchecks against overinterpreting a leading-term coincidence.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; the counting formula is readable, and failure claims are prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Random-matrix characteristic polynomials predict zeta moments
accepted_units.why_material: Transfers a theorem about GUE characteristic polynomials to conjectural asymptotics for all moments of zeta, recovering previously known low moments and predicting higher ones.
accepted_units.context_note: The random-matrix theorem is distinct from its modeled application to zeta; the source presents the latter as a conditional transfer.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equations (38)-(44) contain formula-layout damage and require scan verification for exact constants.

accepted_units.title: A prescribed spectrum does not identify a unique or chaotic classical system
accepted_units.why_material: An inverse-spectrum existence result supplies infinitely many integrable Hamiltonians for broad spectral sequences, warning that spectral matching alone underdetermines the desired mechanism.
accepted_units.context_note: Applied in the source to both primes and critical-line zero ordinates.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; growth assumptions and conclusion are clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: Connes and Okubo relocate rather than resolve the missing proof obligation
accepted_units.why_material: Compares a construction accounting only for critical-line zeros but leaving a trace-formula obstacle with a boundary-condition construction whose eigenfunctions are not normalizable.
accepted_units.context_note: Both examples isolate the residual condition that prevents a formal spectral analogy from proving RH.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; summary-level prose supports the bounded comparison.

accepted_units.title: Trivial zeros admit a harmonic-oscillator operator
accepted_units.why_material: Constructs an explicit differential operator whose evenly spaced eigenvalues reproduce the trivial zeros, contrasting an easy regular spectrum with the unresolved nontrivial spectrum.
accepted_units.context_note: Useful as a controlled example of what a successful spectral realization looks like without implying anything about RH.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equations (45) and the rearranged operator should be scan-checked.

accepted_units.title: Quantum verification proposals can merely repackage classical RH criteria
accepted_units.why_material: Distinguishes constructing unitary encodings of assumed critical-line zeros from an allegedly verifying circuit that only quantum-counts primes against an existing bound.
accepted_units.context_note: The source's criticism is methodological: computational acceleration does not remove the underlying criterion or assumption.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Partition-function zeros motivate a statistical-mechanical RH route
accepted_units.why_material: Frames phase transitions through analytically continued partition-function zeros and notes that functional symmetries and restricted zero loci resemble zeta's structure.
accepted_units.context_note: This is a programmatic bridge, not yet a constructed applicable model.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equation (46) and the prose define the partition-function representation.

accepted_units.title: Logarithmic energies turn unique factorization into a zeta partition function
accepted_units.why_material: Assigns prime-labeled energy levels so many-particle composition mirrors prime factorization, making the canonical partition sum equal to zeta.
accepted_units.context_note: Reuses the unique-factorization mechanism from the Euler-product unit in a physical state-space representation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; the partition-sum identity is formula-dependent but recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Duality and a conformal map translate critical-line localization into a circle problem
accepted_units.why_material: Compares zeta's functional equation to Ising duality, maps the critical line to the unit circle, and proposes using Lee-Yang or Fisher zero-locus theorems after realizing zeta as a suitable partition function.
accepted_units.context_note: The key move is changing geometry from a line to a circle where physical zero theorems apply.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equations (47) and the map are central, though prose states their roles.

accepted_units.title: A zeta-valued spin model falls outside the proven circle-theorem class
accepted_units.why_material: Records a concrete spin-chain realization and the decisive gap: its interactions do not satisfy the hypotheses under which the circle theorem is established.
accepted_units.context_note: Separates successful representation construction from theorem applicability; later KMS inequalities are only summarized.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; the obstruction is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: The Mobius random-walk heuristic suggests a bound that is too strong for RH
accepted_units.why_material: Connects Mobius signs to a symmetric walk, derives how a square-root Mertens bound would imply RH, reports its disproof, and preserves the weaker epsilon-relaxed condition equivalent to RH.
accepted_units.context_note: This sharply distinguishes a useful stochastic analogy from an invalid pointwise conjecture.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; the partial-summation derivation is extraction-damaged, but implication, disproof, and weaker equivalence are clear.

accepted_units.title: A Riemann-Mobius walk locates zeros but tolerates off-line behavior
accepted_units.why_material: Builds a jump distribution directly from Mobius values and shows that general probability laws recover only limited zero localization, not the needed boundary exclusion.
accepted_units.context_note: A negative result: the stochastic representation is compatible with off-critical-line zeros.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; the probability and Fourier formulas are damaged and require scan verification, while the limitation is prose-grounded.

accepted_units.title: Billiard survival asymptotics provide a physically measurable RH condition
accepted_units.why_material: Relates escape probability in open billiards to zeta and gives an RH-equivalent limiting law whose violation could in principle refute RH experimentally.
accepted_units.context_note: The source explicitly notes that no such experiment had been performed and extends the idea to spherical billiards.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equation (48), limit order, and exponents require scan verification.

accepted_units.title: A shaped optical signal physically computes a zeta Fourier transform
accepted_units.why_material: Describes van der Pol's electro-mechanical realization of an integral representation as a paper-disc signal, optical transduction, and analog Fourier transform locating early zeros.
accepted_units.context_note: This is finite measurement of the critical-line function, not verification of all zeros.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; equation (49) and the cutout function need scan checking, but the apparatus pipeline is clear.

accepted_units.title: Electrostatic fields and quasicrystals offer incomplete geometric encodings
accepted_units.why_material: Juxtaposes an electrostatic vector field built from zeta's real and imaginary parts with the proposal that zero locations form a one-dimensional quasicrystal.
accepted_units.context_note: Both routes are source-level sketches: one yields an asymptotic zero equation, while the other lacks the needed classification.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; summary prose only, with no derivation provided.

accepted_units.title: Voronin universality makes local zeta behavior approximate arbitrary nonvanishing analytic functions
accepted_units.why_material: States the approximation theorem and derives a self-similarity interpretation by applying the universality perspective to zeta itself.
accepted_units.context_note: The path-integral application is mentioned only as a downstream use; the selected core is universality as representational richness.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High; theorem hypotheses and equation (50) require scan verification.

accepted_units.title: Reconstructing a potential from zero ordinates yields fractal structure
accepted_units.why_material: Reports a numerically constructed one-dimensional potential whose eigenvalues reproduce known zeros and whose graph is fractal or multifractal.
accepted_units.context_note: This is computational inverse-spectral evidence, not proof of a Hilbert-Polya operator or RH.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Low; summary prose, with construction details absent from the source.

accepted_units.title: Newton iteration turns zeta's many roots into convergence-basin geometry
accepted_units.why_material: Transfers Newton's method from a finite-root polynomial to zeta and visualizes initial points by iterations required to approach a root.
accepted_units.context_note: The representation exposes basin complexity but does not constrain all zero locations.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; equation (51) is readable and the visual semantics are explained in prose.

accepted_units.title: Eventually false inequalities defeat huge ranges of finite confirmation
accepted_units.why_material: Uses sign changes in prime-counting error and the false Mertens bound to show that counterexamples may lie beyond conceivable computation, undercutting extrapolation from extensive checks.
accepted_units.context_note: Connects back to both explicit prime counting and the random-walk section as a source-specific saturation conclusion.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Moderate; extreme numerical bounds are text-layer awkward, but the qualitative warning and named counterexamples are clear.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Prime staircase and spectral oscillations are dual views of zero data
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The source presents zeros simultaneously as collective oscillatory coordinates reconstructing prime discontinuities and as candidate spectral levels of a self-adjoint system.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The explicit formula is analytic, while the spectral operator remains conjectural; the analogy does not establish existence or RH.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Matching a spectrum or its leading count underdetermines the mechanism
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: A leading counting match, an inverse-spectrum existence theorem, or a partial critical-line realization can all reproduce desired data while failing chaos, discreteness, normalizability, or exclusion of off-line zeros.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: These are obstructions to particular inference patterns, not a proof that no valid Hilbert-Polya construction exists.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Arithmetic gas plus circle geometry isolates an applicability bottleneck
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Unique factorization can make zeta a partition function and a conformal map can turn the critical line into a circle, but a circle theorem helps only if the constructed interactions lie in its proven model class.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The cited spin system fails that hypothesis, so the representation bridge alone does not localize all zeros.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Probabilistic intuition must survive pointwise falsification
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Random-walk behavior explains plausible average cancellation, yet sharp pointwise bounds can fail at enormous scales and a probability model may still tolerate off-critical-line zeros.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The weaker epsilon-relaxed Mertens condition remains equivalent to RH; failure of the stronger heuristic does not refute RH.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Physical interfaces turn zeta into signals without turning finite observation into proof
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Wave decompositions, billiard survival, and analog Fourier apparatus translate zeta information into spikes, decay laws, or measured signals.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Finite computation or measurement can test and potentially refute bounded behavior but cannot by itself certify the global zero statement.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Fractal richness is descriptive rather than zero-locus control
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Universality, inverse-spectral fractal potentials, and Newton basins reveal multiple forms of self-similar complexity around zeta.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: None of these representations, as presented, forces every nontrivial zero onto the critical line.

within_source_saturation: Saturated after exhaustive inspection: every coherent source-specific mechanism, criterion, construction, obstruction, representation change, evidence distinction, and falsification warning is selected. Further splitting would predominantly isolate routine derivations, numerical tables, brief unsupported pointers, formula-damaged fragments already guarded by representation notes, or bibliography.
